text: 十年煤控步入深水区，“十五五”煤炭消费如何平稳达峰 煤控不能简单“一刀切”，要走结构优化、渐进替代、区域协同的路径。
text_en: A decade of coal control enters deep waters: how can coal consumption peak smoothly during the 15th Five-Year Plan? Coal control cannot be a simple one-size-fits-all approach; it must follow a path of structural optimization, gradual substitution and regional coordination.
